data.acquired_before_this_protocol: official label tables (stats-REST goalie/summary, skater/summary, api-web schedule) acquired by nhl_engine_feasibility_data.py with schema-only inspection (field names, one season's row counts, starter / period-type value sets); NO analysis result was computed
existing_sources: cached API play-by-play of 7,923 games (2017-2023) for event-level reconciliation
data.seasons: 2017-2025 regular season (2017 history only for any later modelling)

kind: DATA / IDENTIFIABILITY FEASIBILITY AUDIT -- no model is fit, no challenger exists, no hyperparameter is chosen
leak_rule: the postgame fact of who started may be used ONLY as a LABEL / conditioning event of a conditional-on-start component; it is NEVER a pregame feature
leak_safe_contract_to_be_written_in_the_: allowed PIT features (goalie prior-only skill, opponent / own shot environment, schedule / rest, aggregated shared skater state)
forbidden: starter flag as a feature, any target-game TOI / shots / saves / events, sportsbook
mechanistic_target: saves = START / APPEARANCE state x SHOTS-AGAINST distribution x SAVE-PROBABILITY / goals-against process
never: a model fit or performance score
a postgame quantity masquerading as a pregame feature
2024/2025 as selection data for any future head's design (they stay previously-exposed years)
output_rule: every question gets MEASURED numbers and one verdict from the closed set given in the question; a failed question is reported, never waved through
phase: G0 (goalie saves, new standard; the legacy goalie-saves model, AUC 0.5673 / calibration p 0.001, is a historical comparator ONLY)

Q1_appearances_and_starts_identifiable.measure: per (game, team): number of goalie rows (appearances) and number with gamesStarted == 1, all seasons
verdict_set: IDENTIFIABLE (every team-game has exactly one starter)

Q2_starts_vs_relief.measure: share of goalie appearances that are relief (gamesPlayed=1, gamesStarted=0); starter TOI distribution; pulled-starter share; per-season stability

Q3_goalie_skill_state_from_prior_games.measure: for every (target game, team, starter) apply the historical cutoff rule (source_start + 210 min <= T90, != target) to the goalie's own prior appearances (all teams): coverage of starts with >=1 / >=5 / >=10 prior appearances, debut share, season-start effects; leakage assertion that no target or later game is used

Q4_pit_team_shot_generation_state.measure: opponent shots-for / own shots-against environment from prior completed team games (team official SOG = sum of skater SOG, Phase 0A-verified): coverage of target team-games with >=5 prior team games and the early-season fraction without

measure: (a) saves + goalsAgainst == shotsAgainst for every goalie row (exact)

(b) per team-game: sum of the team's goalies' shotsAgainst vs the OPPONENT's skater SOG total (exact equality share, difference distribution, and whether each difference equals the opponent's empty-net goals from the cached API play-by-play, 2017-2023)
(c) a deterministic 200-game sample (SHA256('nhl-goalie-g0-sample-v1|<game_id>') ascending): CURRENT NHL boxscore goalie saves / shots against vs the stats-REST values
verdict_set: RECONCILED_WITH_EXPLAINED_DIFFERENCES (each difference explained by an identified mechanism)

measure: number of starter-games per season and per rolling-origin fold D1-D4 (train 2018-2019 -> val 2020 ... train 2018-2022 -> val 2023; 2024/2025 stay previously-exposed confirmation years)
descriptive saves | start distribution (mean, variance, dispersion vs Poisson)
descriptive association of shotsAgainst with the opponent's PRIOR SOG mean and of save% with the goalie's PRIOR save% (correlations, NO model fitting)
verdict_set: RESEARCHABLE_HISTORICALLY (leak-safe label + PIT features + adequate fold sizes)

measure: can the PIT START probability be validated historically? (historical PIT starter CONFIRMATION is not reconstructable: Phase 0B)
descriptive identifiability of a PRIOR-ONLY start-likelihood: share of starts equal to the team's previous-game starter, split by team back-to-back / rest (no fitting; not a confirmation)
verdict_set: BLOCKED_PENDING_LIVE_CONFIRMATION_EVIDENCE (with a prior-only start-likelihood sub-component marked researchable if its descriptive identifiability supports it)

required_split.GOALIE_SAVES_CONDITIONAL_ON_START_COMPON: researchable historically if Q1-Q6 pass; uses the starter label as conditioning only
required_split.PREGAME_START_PROBABILITY_COMPONENT: BLOCKED (confirmation) pending live forward snapshots; a prior-only sub-component may be researched but is never called a pregame confirmation
required_split.UNCONDITIONAL_PREGAME_GOALIE_SAVES_HEAD: BLOCKED until the start component is certified
